name: ssml-emotion-injector
description: European Portuguese (pt-PT) emotional prosody for the Web Speech API: turns plain text + emotion annotations into acoustically calibrated SSML.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.js --format=esm --bundle --outfile=dist/ssml-emotion-injector.esm.js && esbuild src/index.js --format=esm --bundle --minify --outfile=dist/ssml-emotion-injector.esm.min.js && esbuild src/index.js --format=iife --global-name=SSMLEmotionInjector --bundle --minify --outfile=dist/ssml-emotion-injector.min.js

author: Davide Cogliati
